**Short answer:** for most iPhone owners, get the **Belkin BoostCharge Qi2 15W vent mount** (about $47.99). If your phone supports faster charging and you want the best performance, get the **Anker Prime Qi2 25W** (about $89.99).

## Top picks

**Belkin BoostCharge Magnetic Wireless Charging Car Vent Mount: best overall (~$47.99)**
- It charges at up to 15W and includes a 27W car adapter and a 1 m USB-C cable.
- It rotates between portrait and landscape, and fits cases up to 3 mm thick.
- Vent slats need to be no more than 3 mm thick and 20 mm deep. Straight horizontal slats work best, and vertical ones may sag.
- Source: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [CloudsPress](https://www.cloudspress.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Anker Prime Qi2 25W (MagGo AirCool, A2933): fastest and most reliable (~$89.99, sometimes discounted to ~$69.99)**
- It has active cooling (thermoelectric plus a fan) to prevent heat throttling when you run navigation. [MountGuys](https://www.mountguys.com/best-magsafe-car-mount/) uses it as their daily driver, and [The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/) calls it the most reliable.
- You get 25W on the iPhone 17 and 16 Pro Max/16 Plus. The iPhone 16 and 16 Pro get up to 22W, and iPhone 15 and earlier get about 15W. The iPhone 16e isn't compatible.
- It needs a 45W+ USB-C car adapter for full speed. The Gadgeteer and MountGuys say a 60W adapter is in the box, but check the listing.
- Anker lists it as incompatible with Tesla and Mercedes-Benz vehicles and with cars that have nonstandard vents.
- Source: [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/), [iTechGuides](https://www.itechguides.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/)

**Budget options**
- **ESR HaloLock Qi2 15W with CryoBoost fan:** it mounts on a vent or the dash. Prices vary by source: The Gadgeteer lists it at $18.99, while ESR's own store lists $39.99, or about $32.80 with code PARTNER18 (per [Dealectric](https://dealectric.com/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost)). [Buy at ESR](https://dealectric.com/go/esr-halolock-15w-wireless-car-charger-cryoboost) (affiliate link). A car adapter may not be included.
- **LISEN 15W vent/dash mount:** about $15.99 on Amazon, with both mounting styles. It needs a car port that supplies at least 18W. See the Amazon buttons on [RottenWiFi](https://rottenwifi.com/best-magsafe-car-mounts-in-2026-connect-charge-and-drive/).
- **LISEN Qi2.2 25W with cooling fan:** from $39.95, and a 95W adapter is included ([The Gadgeteer](https://the-gadgeteer.com/2026/06/16/best-magsafe-car-mounts-iphone-2026/)).

## Things to check before buying
- Look for "Qi2" certification. A "MagSafe-compatible" listing without it may only charge at about 7.5W.
- If you drive in hot sun, choose a model with a fan. Passive mounts can throttle.
- Ignore suction or magnet "lbs/gf" claims on cheap listings, since they often describe the suction base rather than how well the phone is held.
- If your vents are thin or angled, a dash or windshield mount such as Belkin's vent/dash version is safer.

**Caveats:** I couldn't open product pages, so I don't have direct Amazon links for the Belkin or Anker. The Amazon buy buttons are on the review pages linked above. Prices come from those reviews and may have changed. Several of the roundups share nearly identical text and carry affiliate links, so I leaned on the mounts that multiple sources agreed on.

Tell me which phone you have and whether your car has horizontal vent slats, and I can narrow it to one pick.
